newsitem.title: USA: AnnTaylor amends deal with Cygne.
newsitem.headline: AnnTaylor amends deal with Cygne.

text.p: AnnTaylor Stores Corp said Wednesday it changed its agreement with Cygne Designs Inc regarding AnnTaylor buying its interest in their direct sourcing joint venture, known as CAT, and Cygne's Woven Division.
The division sources merchandise for AnnTaylor.

As previously announced, a portion of the purchase price for Cygne's interest in CAT and the Woven Division is payable in AnnTaylor common stock valued at $36 million but not more than 2.5 million shares, Jocelyn Barandiaran, general counsel for AnnTaylor, said in a telephone interview.
Under the changed deal, if the 2.5 million shares are not worth at least $32.5 million, AnnTaylor will issue up to 500,000 additional shares.
If the value of three million shares is not $32.5 million, Cygne may terminate the deal under the new terms, Barandiaran said.
Cygne sought the new terms following AnnTaylor's stock volatility early this month, Barandiaran said.

AnnTaylor expects the deal will close sometime in September following approval by Cygne's stockholders at their annual meeting, Barandiaran said. But, she added, there can be no assurance that the transaction will be consumated.
